text.tspan: S6 ADCS on the OBC board and the magnetometer board (version 3)
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · from the build-to netlist SQSO-OBC-BRD-001 sections 9-10 · pins: SQSO-ICX-001 section 4 · each sensor's bus crosses into its rail through a VCC-isolating translator
Trip in 2 us, FAULT after 8 ms pulls EN low: rail off 0.13 s, then retry (latch-up, RADIATION_ANALYSIS 5.3).
PS = GND: gyro SPI; SDO1 + SDO2 joined
via U12/U13 (VCCB 3V3_IMU2): PB13, PB15, PD0, PD4, PB14, PD15
Magnetometer board A2 (+Z end frame): U1 PNI RM3100 (13156)
I2C 0x20 via OBC J10 / W6E, single-shot in the coils-off window
SDA_S / SCL_S via U14 TCA9517 (I2C4 PD12/PD13)
Vout = Isc x 619 Ohm: 2.48 V at 4.0 mA; clips at 5.25 mA; 1.3 uA per LSB (1.5 deg at normal incidence).
Burst: TIM15 ends it at 900 ms by itself; nSLEEP low -> bridges high-Z -> coil current zero within 1.9 ms.
A hung OBC, a stopped clock or an upset timer register cannot hold a coil on past 0.98 s (U25); re-armed only when MTQ_ARM falls.
